name: list_aliases
description:
Retrieves a list of aliases for the authenticated User or Team. When `domain` is provided, only aliases for that domain will be returned. When `projectId` is provided, it will only return the given project aliases.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v4/aliases --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

domain.description: Get only aliases of the given domain name

from.description: Get only aliases created after the provided timestamp

limit.description: Maximum number of aliases to list from a request

rollbackDeploymentId.description: Get aliases that would be rolled back for the given deployment

since.description: Get aliases created after this JavaScript timestamp

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.

until.description: Get aliases created before this JavaScript timestamp
